svg.title: How foreman runs a task
svg.desc: One foreman dispatch run, step by step. A request comes in and the feature template splits it into 6 subtasks: map, build-api, build-ui, docs, review and verify. plan.py check passes the plan with 3 waves before any agent starts. Each subtask goes to an agent on the model its kind of work needs: wave 1 runs the scout on Haiku; wave 2 runs two builders on Sonnet in parallel, and build-ui stops short, so it reruns once on Sonnet at higher effort (a subtask that is wrong after a real try goes one tier up, to Opus); wave 3 runs docs on Haiku and review and verify on Sonnet. Opus and Fable are not needed in this plan. The foreman then checks file ownership, runs the tests once and reads the full diff, and each outcome goes to the run log, which plan.py stats turns into tune hints.

g.text: A request comes in. A one-unit task is done inline, with no agents.
The feature template splits it into 6 subtasks, each with the files it owns and one check.
plan.py check runs before any agent starts: no shared files in a wave, no silent model changes.
Wave 1: the scout maps the code on Haiku.
Wave 2: two builders run in parallel on Sonnet, and build-ui stops short.
A short stop reruns once on the same model at higher effort; a wrong answer goes one tier up.
Wave 3: docs on Haiku, review and verify on Sonnet, all at once.
The foreman checks every changed file against its owner, runs the tests once, reads the diff.
Each outcome goes to the run log, and plan.py stats turns the log into tune hints.
